texto:
Many people say that breakfast is the most important meal of the day. But why is it so special? After a long night of sleep, your body needs energy to start a new day. Breakfast gives you that first push of energy. People who eat a good breakfast often feel more active and can concentrate better at school or work.

Skipping breakfast can make you feel tired and hungry before lunchtime. This sometimes leads to eating unhealthy snacks later. A healthy breakfast doesn't have to be complicated. Simple options like a bowl of cereal with milk, some fruit, or a yogurt are great choices. These foods provide important nutrients like fiber and vitamins.

So, starting your day with a nutritious meal is a simple but powerful way to take care of your health and well-being. It helps your body and your brain work well all morning.

preguntas.pregunta: What is the main idea of the text?

opciones.A: The best types of snacks to eat during the day.
opciones.B: Why eating breakfast is beneficial for your health and energy.
opciones.C: A comparison between different meals like lunch and dinner.
opciones.D: The problems associated with eating too much in the morning.
opciones.E: How to cook complicated breakfast recipes.

preguntas.explicacion: La respuesta correcta es B porque todo el texto explica los beneficios de desayunar para la salud. Menciona que 'Breakfast gives you that first push of energy' y que ayuda a las personas a 'concentrate better'. The other options are incorrect because: A is wrong, the text focuses on breakfast, not snacks. C is not mentioned; there is no comparison with other meals. D and E present ideas that are not discussed in the text.

preguntas.pregunta: According to the text, what can be inferred about skipping breakfast?

opciones.A: Skipping breakfast helps you lose weight.
opciones.B: People who skip breakfast usually eat a very healthy lunch.
opciones.C: It may lead to poor food choices before lunch.
opciones.D: It is a good habit for adults but not for children.
opciones.E: Skipping breakfast gives you more energy in the afternoon.

preguntas.explicacion: La respuesta correcta es C. El texto no lo dice con estas palabras exactas, pero podemos inferirlo de la frase: 'Skipping breakfast can make you feel tired and hungry... This sometimes leads to eating unhealthy snacks later'. Esto sugiere que saltarse el desayuno puede llevar a 'poor food choices'. The other options are incorrect. A and D are not mentioned in the text. B is the opposite of what the text suggests. E is false, as the text states that skipping breakfast can make you feel 'tired'.
